title: Bernette B70 DECO Embroidery Machine

comparisons.notes: Bernette B70 Deco dedicated embroidery machine, SKU BE70, 208 designs, 3 hoops, 260x160mm field; in stock (store data available=true)

writeup: The Bernette b70 DECO is a dedicated embroidery machine with a 5-inch color touchscreen, 208 built-in designs, three hoops with hoop detection and a 260 x 160 mm maximum embroidery area. Woot has it new for $899.99, while Quality Sewing lists the same machine at $1,699, a saving of about $799. Woot covers it with a 90-day limited warranty.
amazon_match_notes: Amazon title matches Woot title exactly: Bernette B70 Deco Sewing Machine with Embroidery Kit, part b70 Deco
